page_title: Free screenshot tool for Windows and Mac | WellSnap

sources.entry: WellSnap - Open-source screenshot tool for macOS and Windows with arrows, numbered callouts, and a blur that never uses the hidden pixels. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/hashtriton/wellsnap) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: WellSnap
summary.one_liner: WellSnap is a free, open-source screenshot tool for Windows and macOS that captures an area, lets you annotate it with arrows, blur and numbered callouts, and paste it with your comments into a chat or document.
use_cases: Annotating bug reports with arrows and numbered callouts
Sending several screenshots with comments to a chat at once
Blurring private details before sharing a screenshot
Combining multiple screenshots into one image for email or tickets
Replacing Windows Snipping Tool with a Print Screen-driven workflow
summary.what_it_does: WellSnap is triggered by Print Screen, which freezes the screen so you can drag a selection. Annotation tools include arrows (Shift snaps to 45°), boxes, a marker, text, pencil, and numbered callouts with comments. Blur is built from surrounding pixels and is described as irreversible. Multiple screenshots can be grouped into a set, sent to a chat as one message, or combined into a single image with headings and comments. Paste with text (Win+Alt+V) places comments and screenshots into apps such as Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord, Word, eM Client and Notepad, without pressing Send. The page states screenshots stay on the computer and are not uploaded.
notable: Paste with text (Win+Alt+V) sends comments and screenshots together into chat apps like Telegram and Discord
Screenshot sets with lettered and numbered callouts (A1, A2, B1)
Open source under GPL-3.0, free with no ads or paid tier
Takes over Print Screen from Windows Snipping Tool and can restore it
caveats: Mac version requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later and Screen Recording permission; paste with text also needs Accessibility
Notepad paste includes only comment text, not pictures
Available in English and Russian only
